items.name: Changeling
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: wide fantasy landscape background for Changeling.
Primary request: Create a NEW original environment painting, landscape 16:9, edge-to-edge.
Scene: A mysterious canal city at twilight, interwoven narrow streets and elegant bridges, pale pearlescent stone buildings reflected in perfectly still water, reflections subtly suggest alternate versions of the architecture, gentle fey mist and silver-blue light. A place of many identities, intriguing and beautiful.
Style references: Image 1 and Image 2 are STYLE references only. Match their atmospheric painterly high fantasy landscape art, broad natural brushwork, soft cinematic illumination, rich muted colors, depth through atmospheric perspective and detailed but restful scenery. Create the requested new environment rather than repeating the reference castle or mountain layout.
Composition: panoramic environmental establishing shot, immersive foreground framing and an open middle distance. Landscape is the subject. No prominent people, no character portraits, no text, no letters, no logos, no borders, no watermarks. Visually coherent scenery suitable behind app content.
